records.finding: Current main contains a bounded cooperative cumulative-budget reservation model and four-method test module. records.topic: Current full-corpus Markdown links and anchors
records.finding: PR #160 scanned 256 Markdown/MDX documents in the current-main b0142c2 PR merge checkout (253 Markdown, 3 MDX). The run processed 2,891 link occurrences (1,318 unique): 1,641 accepted, 82 errors, and 1,168 excluded. All 82 errors are confined to partial upstream snapshots: 44 MCP root-absolute site paths, 32 OCI omitted-document links, and six Alive2 omitted assets/README links. No unresolved LLMLang-authored local link or available-target anchor was reported. External URLs were offline; non-Markdown resources and index completeness were not checked. E-02 PR #169 additionally checked the 17 curated external URLs: 16 returned content and POSIX returned 403 to the checker (indeterminate); this is not a corpus-wide external URL scan.
records.required_action: Integrate E PR #160 after review; preserve upstream snapshot closure gaps and complete external URL, non-Markdown resource, and index-coverage audits separately.
